facets.description: isAccessTokenId reads the grant shortcut with substring(3,5) instead of substring(4,6), the last 2 chars of the 6-char prefix
isAccessTokenId's equality check is inverted: it returns false when the grant shortcut matches, so it never checks the grant
No check that the prefix is 6 chars long before calling substring, so a short prefix can throw StringIndexOutOfBounds
item.split(":") is called without a limit; it should use split(":", 2)
